capabilities: record speech and transcribe it to text
clean up transcribed text with grammar and punctuation
insert text at the cursor or auto-create voice notes
organize voice notes into category folders and attach audio
choose output styles, languages, and live dictation
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff per manifest. Audio is uploaded to AICHE servers and deleted immediately after transcription; requires internet connection, with a 7-day free trial then plans starting at $4.99/month.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn spoken speech into polished, readable note text with grammar and punctuation handled.

relations.evidence: Part of AICHE - one subscription, voice-to-text everywhere: desktop apps, Obsidian, mobile, browser.

summary: Voice dictation plugin that records speech and inserts cleaned-up, punctuated text into notes, powered by a paid AICHE account and subscription.
